# Füll Process Group

> Füll Process S.A. (Weinfelden, Thurgau, Switzerland) is the parent company of the Füll Process Group.
> Its four companies develop and build gravimetric and volumetric dosing systems, agitators,
> storage systems and laboratory automation, and produce high-quality nail and beauty products
> as a private-label partner. Markets: paints and coatings, printing inks, sealants and adhesives,
> cosmetics, food, flavours, fine chemicals, textiles and crop protection.

## Group companies
- [Füll Systembau GmbH](https://fuell-dispensing.com/): gravimetric and volumetric dosing systems, agitators, storage systems, customer-specific process automation; Idstein, Germany; dosing technology since 1965; 2500+ dosing and tank systems installed worldwide
- [Tecos Bruhin AG](https://tecosbruhinag.ch/): gravimetric dosing systems for pasty liquids, engineering services for industrial dosing and automation; Moosgrabenstrasse 12, 8595 Altnau, Switzerland
- [Füll Lab Automation GmbH](https://www.fuell-labautomation.com/): automation solutions for high-throughput development and quality control of liquid, powdered and pasty materials; Ostfildern, Germany
- [POLYSTONE Chemical GmbH](https://polystone-chemical.de/): develops and manufactures high-quality colour and beauty products (UV gel nail products, permanent make-up) as a private-label partner for nail brands, PMU brands, retail and creator brands worldwide; around 40 years of experience, over 2,000 products in more than 90 countries; production exclusively in Blieskastel (Germany) and Bitche (France); certified to Cosmetics GMP DIN EN ISO 22716:2008, meets DIN EN ISO 9001:2015
